name: bg
summary: Resumes a suspended job in the background.
description: Shell builtin. After suspending a program with Ctrl+Z, bg starts it again in the background: it keeps running while you get the terminal back. Without an argument, bg acts on the current job (marked + in jobs).

arguments.name: %JOB
arguments.description: Job to resume: %1, %2… (numbers shown by jobs).

examples.explanation: Resumes in the background the last job suspended with Ctrl+Z.
